name: Dual Contouring with Distance and Hermite Energy Optimization
definition: A method for reconstructing a quad mesh from Signed Distance Function (SDF) data on a regular grid. It locally updates vertex positions per cell to minimize a combined energy of distance to SDF samples and Hermite consistency, avoiding global geometric flow.
summary: Dual Contouring with Distance and Hermite Energy Optimization reconstructs quad meshes from SDF data by iteratively minimizing local energy to recover sharp features without requiring exact Hermite data or derivatives.
